instrument: Ample Bass P Lite (sampled electric bass)
source: Range found by rendering every note: 41 and above play at full level, 40 is very quiet, 13-39 are silent.

playable_range.note: write bass lines from MIDI 41 up; the top of the range was not probed above 71

tips: The lowest usable note is F (41): for a song in E play the root at 52 instead of 40.
Do not send low keyswitch notes: nothing below 40 produces sound here.
Short eighth notes (about 0.4 beat) with alternating velocities give a driving picked line.
